clips.title: The story
paras: Shalzaru's Lair is a sprawling, submerged cavern located at the northern tip of the Isle of Dread in Feralas. It serves as a major stronghold for the Hatecrest naga and shelters their formidable master, Shalzaru. From within these damp tunnels, the serpentine invaders coordinate their aggressive presence just south of Feathermoon Stronghold.

Carved into the rugged bluffs at the northern end of the Isle of Dread, Shalzaru's Lair is divided into a massive main cavern and a smaller auxiliary chamber, linked together by submerged subterranean waterways. The interior teems with Hatecrest serpent guards and spell-weaving sorceresses on high alert. Deep within the recesses dwells Lord Shalzaru, the serpentine overlord directing the Hatecrest brood across the island. Its proximity to Sardor Isle poses a direct, constant threat to the night elf Sentinels garrisoned at Feathermoon Stronghold just across the channel.
